title: Surreal Clock Tower Landscape
description: A massive teal clock tower with a glowing orb base stands at the center of a vibrant green landscape, surrounded by floating colorful spheres, butterflies, and birds. The scene is framed within a large circular portal against a beige background, with a dirt path leading to the tower, rolling hills, standing stones, and a small house in the foreground.
prompt: A surreal fantasy landscape featuring a giant teal clock tower with a white clock face and glowing golden orb at its base, centered within a large circular portal. The scene shows rolling green hills, a winding dirt path, ancient standing stones, a small house, and distant mountains. Numerous colorful butterflies, birds, and floating spheres in red, blue, orange and silver drift around the tower against a soft beige sky, in a whimsical dreamlike style.
